paragraphs.text: Crown Technical Systems proposes a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup to meet the customer's requirements as outlined in the RFP. This lineup includes eighteen 15 kV vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of 15 kV isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs). Future bays are designed to be fully functional, excluding the vacuum circuit breakers.
